ctx.x: Well, the next album we come up with, Dave comes back and says, 'We're going to make an album called

Swinging on Broadway." Now it's got all show tunes in there, and he brought out a number and he said, "Now, this is going to be the featured number in here. This is Baubles, Bangles and Beads." Well, I never heard of, "Baubles, Bangles and Beads." So he passed out the piano copy, he give us all four the piano copy, and I said, "Well, I've got to transpose mine a note higher."
